title: REPUBLIC OF KOREA — ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE PUBLIC DIPLOMACY ACT
full_text:
REPUBLIC OF KOREA — ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE PUBLIC DIPLOMACY ACT
[Attached Form] Application for Designation as a Public Diplomacy Implementing Organization

※ Do not complete the dark-shaded boxes.
Receipt No.: __________        Date of Receipt: __________        Processing Period: 14 days

Applicant
Name of Organization: ______________________________  Name of Representative: ____________________________
Date of Establishment: _____________________________  Telephone Number: _________________________________
Address: ___________________________________________________________________________________________

Pursuant to Article 12 (1) of the Public Diplomacy Act and Article 11 (2) of the Enforcement Decree of that Act, I/we hereby apply for designation as a public diplomacy implementing organization as described above.

Date: Year __________ Month __________ Day __________
Applicant: ________________________________________ (signature or seal)
To: Minister of Foreign Affairs

Documents to be submitted by the applicant:
1. One copy of the articles of incorporation (only if the applicant is a corporation).
2. One copy of the business plan.
3. One copy of a statement on the personnel with relevant expertise, organizational structure, and facilities available for performing the projects referred to in each subparagraph of Article 12 (2) of the Public Diplomacy Act.
Fee: None.

Matter to be verified by the official in charge:
Certificate of registered matters of the corporation (only if the applicant is a corporation).

Processing procedure:
Preparation of application (applicant) → Receipt (processing authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs) → Review (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) → Designation (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) → Notice (Ministry of Foreign Affairs).

Paper size: 210 mm × 297 mm [white paper, 80 g/m²].
Korean source reference: law0126362025123035947KC_000000F.hwp / law0126362025123035947KC_000000F.pdf.
This English form is a new draft translated from the Korean text held in the source XML. It is not an official English version.
